notes.title: Steel Sword Story has a brand new hard mode! For those seeking a challenge, this new “Gamer” mode is for you!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Orthodox 2D Side Scrolling Action Game “Steel Sword Story” has got a brand new Hard mode.
Choose the “Gamer” mode from the title screen and prepare yourself for a brutal challenge.   

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/573e1a664b21f366e2b17d7f5ad4bf2973a51ffd.png[/img]

[b]Gamer mode adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main character Azul’s HP and MP have been lowered.
[*] Enemy actions and movements have been updated.
[/list]
Enemies move faster, hit harder and have more moves, making combat challenging but fair.

This mode won’t make it easy for you at all.
Can you manage a no death run?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/639fe969dea346bc35b5093bf08be69b110cf059.gif[/img]

Also the new version has been optimized so frame rate and other performance issues have been smoothed out for an all round better gaming experience.

Take up the challenge! Steel Sword Story Gamer Mode is waiting for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978190/Steel_Sword_Story/

notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights]100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.content:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif[/img]
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg[/img]
 
[i]To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug[/i]
 
Also, we’ve implemented [b]fixes for the “Dash”[/b] feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif[/img]
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

notes.title: [Touhou Luna Nights] Announcing the End of Early Access and Adding Stage 4 & 5 at the end of February
notes.content:
Hi Everyone 

Thank you for your continuous support and for your positive comments on our Stage 4 & 5 preview we posted before. 

This huge update is currently planned for the end of February! We hope that you're patiently waiting for the new stage's boss fights!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/dcf481c6edd116112bda48a4bf8a180e568e2eca.gif[/img]

Also, with this update, we will be ending Early Access. 
Once we have left Early Access, the game will be increasing in price to $17.99! If you are wondering whether to grab the game, we recommend grabbing it now during the Luna New Year Sale!

Furthermore, with this huge update, we will also be adding French into the game! 

After we have finished Early Access, we have a few more updates planned. For this, we are looking to add an extra stage and a boss rush. 
In the extra stage, a certain person is finally going to appear...!

We hope that you are looking forward to this update. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/


In the Luna New Year Sale, our other titles such as "Angels of Death" and "Noel the Mortal Fate" are also 20% off, so please take this chance to check them out too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/537110/Angels_of_Death/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/850000/Noel_The_Mortal_Fate_S17/
